title: Faceted distributions
intent: Compare Palmer Penguins body-mass distributions by species on shared quantitative scales.

ai.create: Create vertically faceted proportional histograms directly from Palmer Penguins rows by grouping the public binX transform by species, normalizing each species count to its own sum, and sharing the x and y domains.
ai.maintain: Change the fixed bin boundaries while preserving explicit species order, facet-local sum normalization, aggregate source lineage, and shared outer scale semantics.
